questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Break
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Mend**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Break"** means to separate into parts with suddenness or violence. (तोड़ना)

 
 
• **Example: **He had to **break **the glass to get into the house.
 
 
 
• **"Mend" **refers to repairing something that is broken or damaged. (मरम्मत करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She learned how to **mend **her clothes when they got torn.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Break'** is **'Mend'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Divide** (विभाजित करना): To separate into parts or groups.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher **decided **to divide the class into two groups.
 
 
 
• **Split** (फाड़ना): To break or cause to break forcibly into parts.
 
 
• **Example: **They had to **split **the logs for the fireplace.
 
 
 
• **Breach** (उल्लंघन): An act of breaking or failing to observe a law, agreement, or code of conduct.
 
 
• **Example:** There was a security **breach **at the company last night.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that contains an error.

options.text: The Mona Lisa is a famous painting by Leonardo da Vinci.
She is the only person who can speak five languages fluently.
He is a doctor who specialises in the treating rare diseases.
I saw the movie that won the Academy Award for Best Picture.

questions.solution:

• The error in **Option 3** is the use of the phrase "**in the treating rare diseases**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**in treating rare diseases**."

• Specialises in should be followed directly by the verb in its gerund form "**treating**."

• **Option 4:** The sentence "I saw the movie that won the Academy Award for Best Picture." is correct. It correctly describes an action and specifies the movie.

questions.question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A number which is used to divide another number
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Divisor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Divisor"** means a number by which another number is to be divided. (भाजक)
 
• ​**"Divisor"** is a mathematical term used for the number that divides another number without leaving a remainder. (भाजक)
 
 
• **Example: **In the division of 20 by 4, the number 4 is the **divisor**.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Divisible** (भाज्य): Capable of being divided by another number without leaving a remainder.

 
 
• **Example:** 10 is **divisible **by 2.
 
 
 
• **Quotient** (भागफल): The result obtained by dividing one number by another.
 
 
• **Example: **In 12 ÷ 4 = 3, the number 3 is the **quotient**.
 
 
 
• **Remainder** (शेषफल): The amount left over after division when one number does not divide the other exactly.
 
 
• **Example:** When 17 is divided by 5, the **remainder **is 2.

After I complete my training program / I will have been joining a team of astronauts / and preparing to / embark on a mission to Mars.

options.text: I will have been joining a team of astronauts
embark on a mission to Mars
After I complete my training program

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**I will have been joining a team of astronauts'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence segment "**I will have been joining**" is incorrect because it uses the future perfect continuous tense improperly.
 
• The future perfect continuous tense ("**will have been joining**") is used for actions that will be ongoing up to a specific point in the future, but here it makes the sentence awkward and incorrect.
 
• The correct tense to use in this sentence is the future simple tense: "**will be joining**".

​Therefore, the correct answer is: '**Option 1**'

Correct sentence: *After I complete my training program, **I will be joining a team of astronauts** and preparing to embark on a mission to Mars*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
